        try {
            var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
            return (string)(body?["model"]?.ToString()) ?? "unknown";
        } catch { return "unknown"; }
    }" />

This route expects a native Anthropic Messages body, e.g. {\"model\":\"<deployment>\",\"max_tokens\":1024,\"messages\":[...]}.     <set-variable name="looksOpenAi" value="@{
        try {
            var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
            if (body == null) { return false; }
            foreach (var f in new[] { "frequency_penalty", "presence_penalty", "stream_options", "max_completion_tokens", "logprobs", "top_logprobs", "n" }) {
                if (body[f] != null) { return true; }
            }
            var msgs = body["messages"] as JArray;
            if (msgs != null) {
                foreach (var m in msgs) {
                    var roleTok = m["role"];
                    if (roleTok != null && ((string)roleTok).ToLowerInvariant() == "system") { return true; }
                }
            }
            return false;
        } catch { return false; }
    }" />
    
      
        
          
          
            application/json
          
          {"error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","code":"WireFormatMismatch","message":"This endpoint serves the NATIVE Anthropic Messages API, but the request body is OpenAI chat/completions shaped (it contains a system role message and/or OpenAI-only fields such as frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, stream_options, max_completion_tokens, logprobs, top_logprobs or n). This gateway validates wire formats and does not silently convert between them. Fix: to send Anthropic Messages, hoist the system prompt to the top level 'system' field, include 'max_tokens', and drop the OpenAI-only fields. To keep sending OpenAI bodies, point the client at the '/openai' route instead (Copilot CLI: COPILOT_PROVIDER_TYPE=azure or openai). See docs/architecture.md.","expected_format":"anthropic.messages","alternate_route":"/openai"}}
        
      
    

    
    
    

    
    
    
    
    
      
        
          
          
            application/json
          
          @{
              var model = ((string)context.Variables["deploymentName"]).Trim();
              string supported = "[]";
              string supportedText = "";
              try {
                  var map = Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["activeModelTypesJson"]);
                  var entry = map[model] as Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JArray;
                  if (entry != null) {
                      supported = entry.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                      var parts = new System.Collections.Generic.List();
                      foreach (var t in entry) { parts.Add((string)t); }
                      supportedText = string.Join(", ", parts);
                  }
              } catch { }
              return "{\"error\":{\"type\":\"invalid_request_error\",\"code\":\"UnsupportedApiTypeForModel\",\"message\":\"Model '" + model + "' does not support the Anthropic 'messages' API surface on this route. Supported surfaces: " + supportedText + ". Send this model to the '/openai' route instead.\",\"model\":\"" + model + "\",\"requested_type\":\"messages\",\"supported_types\":" + supported + "}}";
          }
        
      
    

    
    
      
      
      
      
      
    

    
    
      
      
      
      
    

    

    
    @{
        try {
            var body = context.Request.Body?.As<JObject>(preserveContent: true);
            if (body == null) { return context.Request.Body?.As<string>(preserveContent: true); }
            bool changed = false;
            if (body["max_tokens"] == null) { body["max_tokens"] = 4096; changed = true; }
            var tpv = body["top_p"];
            if (tpv != null && (tpv.Type == JTokenType.Float || tpv.Type == JTokenType.Integer) && (double)tpv < 0.99) { body.Remove("top_p"); changed = true; }
            return changed ? body.ToString() : context.Request.Body?.As<string>(preserveContent: true);
        } catch {
            return context.Request.Body?.As<string>(preserveContent: true);
        }
    }

                  }
                
                <set-variable name="commercialSpToken" value="@{

                        var j = resp.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                        return (string)(j["access_token"]) ?? "";
                    } catch { return ""; }
                }" />
